title: International Postgraduate Diploma in Hospitality and Tourism (Level 7)
description: This programme is designed to enhance your understanding and develop skills to work in and manage the hospitality and tourism business effectively.
longDescription: The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Management of Hospitality and Tourism is designed to fit around work and personal commitments. World-class teaching is delivered via pre-recorded online lectures to enrich the learning experience. GSS has perfected the art of delivering practical innovation and development skills. Our practice-based approach focuses on addressing real-world business problems. We don’t just give you the theory; we ensure you learn how to apply it in your working life immediately, with case studies, webinars, business simulations, and 100% project-based. The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Management of Hospitality and Tourism allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. This programme aims to deliver practical and realistic solutions to the challenges in the hospitality and tourism industry, which in turn is supported by appropriate reference to theoretical and conceptual analysis.
courseDetails: Mode of Study: Blended Assessment: Research-based Assignments The objective of the International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Management of Hospitality and Tourism qualification is to enhance your understanding and develop skills to work in and manage the hospitality and tourism business effectively. This qualification reflects current practices in destination management, communicating in hospitality and leading tourism business and allows learners to develop and expand their high-level understanding of financing, managing and leading a booming tourism and hospitality business model. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme consists of 6 modules with a total of 120 credits.
courseDetailParagraphs: The objective of the International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Management of Hospitality and Tourism qualification is to enhance your understanding and develop skills to work in and manage the hospitality and tourism business effectively.

This qualification reflects current practices in destination management, communicating in hospitality and leading tourism business and allows learners to develop and expand their high-level understanding of financing, managing and leading a booming tourism and hospitality business model.
This programme consists of 6 modules with a total of 120 credits.
entry: An honours degree in a related subject or the UK level 6 diploma or equivalent overseas qualification, i.e. Bachelors Degree or Higher National Diploma
Mature learners (over 25) with at least five years of management experience if they do not possess the above qualification (this is reviewed on a case-by-case basis)

accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up Upon completing this course, students can complete a Master's degree programme from one of our Partner Universities. The top-up programme can be studied online. The top-up may comprise the study of a few modules or a final dissertation project. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) For more details and partner Universities offering the topup, please speak to our student advisors.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

outcomes: Analyze Complex Management Problems: Analyze and evaluate complex management problems and challenges within the tourism and hospitality industry, considering multiple perspectives and applying critical thinking skills to propose effective solutions.

Apply Specialist Skills: Apply specialist skills and technical terminology relevant to tourism and hospitality management, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of industry-specific concepts and practices.

Adapt to Changing Environments: Adapt and respond effectively to dynamic and evolving environments in the tourism and hospitality industry, considering factors such as globalization, sustainability, and technological advancements.
Utilize Best Practices: Utilize best practices and contemporary research to inform decision-making and propose innovative strategies for managing tourism and hospitality operations.

Demonstrate Lifelong Learning Orientation: Develop a lifelong learning orientation, seeking opportunities for professional development, staying updated with industry trends, and continuously enhancing knowledge and skills.
Foster Sustainable Practices: Understand and promote sustainable practices within the tourism and hospitality industry, considering the social, economic, and environmental impacts of operations.
Exhibit Effective Leadership: Exhibit effective leadership skills in managing tourism and hospitality teams and organizations, fostering a positive work culture and inspiring high performance.
Apply Marketing Strategies: Develop and implement effective marketing strategies tailored to the tourism and hospitality industry, considering target markets, consumer behaviour, and emerging trends.
